messages:
carol: Hotfix candidate: v2.3.7-hotfix.7 failing prod auth handshake (INF-981). Need expedited deploy approval to push revert of header normalization. @alice @bob @dave please review, target change window now.

deploy-bot: Pipeline started: hotfix/INF-981 -> canary (us-east-1). Steps: unit -> integration -> smoke. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/482

alice: What's the rollback plan? Are we pinning the previous image? How long is the change window?

carol: Rollback plan: immediate image pin to gcr/redwood/inference:v2.3.6-prod and traffic shift back via runtime proxy. Change window = 15m. Rollback thresholds: error rate increase > +1% absolute OR p95 latency > 200ms. Release notes snippet below.

carol: ```release-note
Hotfix: fix auth handshake regression caused by header normalization. Revert normalization for Authorization header in gateway. Affects: hosted + dedicated.
```

bob: LGTM. Verified smoke on staging, no auth regressions. Approving expedited deploy :thumbsup:

dave: Approve. Start canary at 10% weight, observe 10m then ramp if green. Paging infra-oncall: @infra-oncall

infra-oncall: oncall ack — I'll monitor errors, latency, and auth failures. Alerts configured (errors, 5xx, auth-timeouts). Standing by for the 0-30m window.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed (10%) at 2026-03-20T14:07:12Z. Health checks: all passing. Brief metrics snapshot: error_rate +0.12% (baseline 0.30%), auth timeouts unchanged.

alice: Also add runtime pin: runtime-image=redwood/runtime:1.14.3-hotfix.7 to avoid kernel mismatch with dedicated GPU nodes.

release-bot: CHANGELOG updated: "v2.3.7-hotfix.7 — Hotfix: revert header normalization to fix auth handshake". Entry: https://changelog.redwood/internal/482

carol: Applying ramp to 100% now per approvals.

deploy-bot: Rolled to 100% at 2026-03-20T14:19:03Z. No regressions detected in first 12m summary: error_rate delta within threshold, p95 stable.

dave: Thanks team. I'll post a brief note to #incidents and mark INF-981 for closure after docs update.

carol: Thanks everyone for the quick approvals. Filing follow-up task: add unit+integration tests for Authorization header normalization and add canary smoke for auth handshake. :white_check_mark:
